title: Special Executive Programme In Current Issues In Marketing
description: The course aims to address current issues in marketing by examining consumer behavior, cultural influences, and global market strategies.
longDescription: This course explores the complexities of consumer interactions, culture-based attitudes, and global marketing trends. Students will learn about international marketing challenges, global branding strategies, and the impact of cultural dynamics on marketing decisions.
courseDetails: Through a focus on cross-cultural marketing, globalization, and consumer behavior, students will explore the key issues shaping modern marketing. The course covers essential topics such as market entry strategies, brand piracy protection, pricing models, and the selection of international distribution channels. Special attention is given to the influence of cultural factors on consumer preferences and marketing strategies across different regions. modules.title: Current Issues In Marketing
modules.summary: This course addresses critical topics in contemporary marketing, emphasizing the intersection of consumer behavior, cultural identity, and global marketing strategies. Students will delve into the effects of globalization on branding, pricing, and market entry, as well as the challenges posed by international trade barriers and cultural differences. A blend of theory and case studies ensures a practical understanding of these global marketing issues.
